children: Source: USDA
This summary is based on reports from exporters for the period August 28 - September 3, 2026.

Wheat: Net sales of 194,200 metric tons (MT) for 2026/2027--a marketing-year low--were down 38 percent from the previous week and 43 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases primarily for the Philippines (88,400 MT), Ecuador (30,000 MT switched from Panama), Mexico (28,500 MT, including decreases of 16,000 MT), Japan (22,200 MT, including decreases of 13,000 MT), and Honduras (19,000 MT), were offset by reductions for Panama (20,500 MT) and unknown destinations (12,000 MT). Total net sales of 2,500 MT for 2027/2028 were for Mexico. Exports of 493,600 MT were up 4 percent from the previous week and 3 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Mexico (117,300 MT), Indonesia (69,300 MT), Vietnam (65,900 MT), the Philippines (59,500 MT), and Bangladesh (58,300 MT).
Export Adjustments: Accumulated exports of white wheat to Vietnam were adjusted down 2,048 MT for week ending August 27. This export was reported in error.

Corn: Net sales of 1,928,700 MT for the 2026/2027 marketing year, which began September 1, were primarily for Mexico (861,100 MT, including decreases of 13,500 MT), Japan (294,300 MT, including decreases of 62,000 MT), Colombia (174,100 MT, including 40,000 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 5,800 MT), South Korea (96,900 MT), and Taiwan (92,700 MT, including decreases of 100 MT). A total of 15,597,200 MT in sales were carried over from the 2025/2026 marketing year, which ended August 31. Exports for the period ending August 31, of 953,600 MT brought accumulated exports to 86,014,300 MT, up 25 percent from the prior year's total of 69,081,400 MT. The destinations were primarily to Japan (358,100 MT), Mexico (124,200 MT), Spain (105,300 MT), Colombia (100,700 MT), and South Korea (73,700 MT). Exports for September 1-3 of 775,400 MT were primarily to Mexico (356,700 MT), Colombia (124,300 MT), South Korea (73,000 MT), Thailand (68,400 MT), and Spain (62,200 MT).
Optional Origin Sales: For 2025/2026, optional origin sales totaling 62,000 MT, all Japan, which ended August 31, were carried over to the 2026/2027 marketing year.
Barley: Net sales of 800 MT for 2026/2027 were primarily for Canada. Exports of 600 MT were to Canada.

Sorghum: Net sales of 11,700 MT for the 2026/2027 marketing year, which began September 1, were primarily for China (6,900 MT), unknown destinations (2,800 MT), Mexico (1,000 MT), and Japan (900 MT). A total of 32,700 MT in sales were carried over from the 2025/2026 marketing year, which ended August 31. No exports were reported for the period ending August 31. Accumulated exports of 5,085,500 MT were up noticeably from the prior year's total of 1,784,700 MT. Exports for September 1-3 of 3,100 MT were to China (2,100 MT) and Mexico (1,000 MT).

Rice: Net sales of 51,300 MT for 2026/2027 primarily for Japan (13,000 MT), the Dominican Republic (10,000 MT), Haiti (7,000 MT), Canada (6,500 MT, including decreases of 900 MT), and El Salvador (6,200 MT, including 6,000 MT switched from unknown destinations), were offset by reductions for unknown destinations (6,000 MT). Exports of 12,800 MT were primary to El Salvador (6,200 MT), Canada (2,900 MT), Mexico (1,500 MT), Taiwan (1,000 MT), and South Korea (700 MT).

Soybeans: Net sales of 2,637,300 MT for 2026/2027 marketing year, which began September 1, were primarily for China (1,222,000 MT), unknown destinations (245,600 MT, including decreases of 55,000 MT), Indonesia (222,200 MT, including decreases of 1,000 MT), Mexico (169,300 MT), and Taiwan (122,700 MT). A total of 18,748,800 MT in sales were carried over from the 2025/2026 marketing year, which ended August 31. Exports for the period ending August 31 of 251,000 MT brought accumulated exports to 41,006,500 MT, down 18 percent from the prior year's total of 50,105,900 MT. The primary destinations were the Netherlands (58,400 MT), Egypt (58,300 MT), Bangladesh (57,300 MT), Mexico (43,300 MT), and Indonesia (7,400 MT). Exports of 180,600 MT for September 1-3 were primarily to Spain (72,500 MT), Egypt (56,900 MT), Algeria (45,400 MT), Indonesia (2,400 MT), and Vietnam (2,000 MT).
Exports for Own Account: For 2025/2026, exports for own account totaling 1,800 MT, all Taiwan, which ended August 31, were carried over to the 2026/2027 marketing year.

Soybean Cake and Meal: Net sales of 42,600 MT for 2025/2026 were up 45 percent from the previous week, but down 43 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases primarily for Japan (24,100 MT, including decreases of 1,000 MT), Colombia (14,400 MT, including 13,000 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 3,200 MT), Mexico (12,200 MT), Venezuela (11,000 MT, including 10,000 MT switched from unknown destinations), and Cuba (6,700 MT, including decreases of 200 MT), were offset by reductions primarily for unknown destinations (23,000 MT), Canada (5,500 MT), the United Kingdom (1,500 MT), the Philippines (1,000 MT), and Honduras (600 MT). Net sales of 284,500 MT for 2026/2027 were primarily for unknown destinations (50,000 MT), Mexico (41,200 MT), Morocco (38,000 MT), Honduras (37,500 MT), and Portugal (30,000 MT). Exports of 248,300 MT were up 26 percent from the previous week, but down 5 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Colombia (75,700 MT), Mexico (46,400 MT), Spain (29,500 MT), the United Kingdom (28,500 MT), and Nicaragua (14,400 MT).

Optional Origin Sales: For 2025/2026, decreases of 2,000 MT were for Ecuador. The current outstanding balance of 2,000 MT, all Ecuador. For 2026/2027, the current outstanding balance of 3,500 MT, all Ecuador.

Soybean Oil: Total net sales of 100 MT for 2025/2026 were down 94 percent from the previous week and down noticeably from the prior 4-week average. Increases were for Canada. Exports of 800 MT were down 56 percent from the previous week and 50 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destination was Canada.

Cotton: Net sales of Upland totaling 73,900 RB for 2026/2027 were primarily for Pakistan (19,400 RB), Vietnam (17,500 RB, including decreases of 100 RB), Mexico (11,900 RB, including decreases of 200 RB), Bangladesh (10,500 RB), and India (9,500 RB, including decreases of 6,700 RB). Total net sales of 2,500 RB for 2027/2028 were for Mexico. Exports of 177,800 RB were primarily to Vietnam (50,300 RB), India (47,000 RB), Pakistan (17,600 RB), Honduras (11,800 RB), and Mexico (11,000 RB). Net sales of Pima totaling 10,000 RB for 2026/2027 were primarily for India (6,600 RB), Peru (1,900 RB), Thailand (500 RB), Bangladesh (400 RB), and Italy (400 RB). Exports of 5,200 RB were to India (2,400 RB), Pakistan (1,700 RB), Thailand (700 RB), Peru (300 RB), and South Korea (200 RB).

Exports for Own Account: For 2026/2027, new exports for own account totaling 31,200 RB were to Vietnam (16,500 RB) and India (14,700 RB). Exports for own account totaling 7,400 MT to India were applied to new or outstanding sales. The current exports for own account outstanding balance of 72,400 RB were to India (46,500 RB), Vietnam (25,400 RB), and Turkey (500 RB).

Hides and Skins: Net sales of 143,500 pieces for 2026 were down 50 percent from the previous week and 47 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases primarily for China (99,300 whole cattle hides, including decreases of 2,300 pieces), Brazil (28,700 whole cattle hides, including decreases of 4,300 pieces), Thailand (17,700 whole cattle hides, including decreases of 100 pieces), South Korea (8,600 whole cattle hides, including decreases of 1,500 pieces), and Mexico (4,800 whole cattle hides, including decreases of 6,600 pieces), were offset by reductions for Taiwan (17,100 pieces) and Italy (4,300 pieces). Exports of 190,100 whole cattle hides were down 43 percent from the previous week and 29 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to China (120,500 pieces), Mexico (34,000 pieces), South Korea (17,000 pieces), Thailand (12,900 pieces), and Turkey (1,500 pieces).

Net sales of 102,100 wet blues were reported for 2026. Increases primarily for Vietnam (37,000 unsplit, including decreases of 100 unsplit), China (28,800 unsplit), Thailand (20,900 unsplit), Italy (12,200 unsplit), and Guyana (2,900 unsplit), were offset by reductions for Hong Kong (100 unsplit). Total net sales reductions of 2,900 unsplit for 2027 were for Guyana. No net sales or exports of other excluding wet blues were reported for the week. Exports of 181,600 wet blues were up 74 percent from the previous week and 52 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Vietnam (83,100 unsplit), Italy (25,400 unsplit), Brazil (25,200 unsplit), China (14,600 unsplit and 2,400 grain splits), and Thailand (13,600 unsplit). Total net sales reductions of 43,000 splits were for China. No exports of splits were reported for the week.

Beef: Net sales of 8,600 MT for 2026 were down 34 percent from the previous week and 25 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases were primarily for Japan (3,200 MT, including decreases of 300 MT), China (1,600 MT), Mexico (900 MT, including decreases of 300 MT), South Korea (800 MT, including decreases of 1,900 MT), and Hong Kong (700 MT, including decreases of 500 MT). Total net sales of 100 MT for 2027 were for Japan. Exports of 11,500 MT were down 4 percent from the previous week and from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to South Korea (3,600 MT), Japan (2,200 MT), China (1,500 MT), Mexico (1,200 MT), and Taiwan (900 MT).

Pork: Net sales of 27,400 MT for 2026 were down 22 percent from the previous week and 20 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases were primarily for Mexico (16,600 MT, including decreases of 300 MT), Japan (3,200 MT, including decreases of 200 MT), China (1,600 MT), Colombia (1,200 MT, including decreases of 300 MT), and Honduras (1,000 MT, including 100 MT switched from Guatemala). Total net sales of 1,400 MT for 2027 were for Australia. Exports of 30,200 MT were up 1 percent from the previous week and 2 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Mexico (14,500 MT), Japan (3,200 MT), South Korea (3,100 MT), China (2,500 MT), and Canada (2,300 MT).
